title: Norm contraction of a low degree projection
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the Boolean cube with the uniform probability measure. The $L^2$ norm of the Fourier truncation of $f$ to sets of size at most $k$ is at most the $L^2$ norm of $f$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $k\in\mathbb N$. Then $\|f^{\le k}\|_2\le\|f\|_2$.
